boundary: This is a self-covariant of the faithful four-dimensional carrier; constructing a physical E8-to-coexact coupling still requires an explicit carrier-level functor.

representation.source: official ATLAS integral four-dimensional chi21 representation reduced at a good prime

theorem: The four cubic 5:8 self-covariants do not extend to 2.U4(2). In fact there are no nontrivial full-group self-covariants in degrees 2 through 6, while a unique degree-seven self-covariant survives. Thus the first full-group nonlinear channel is septic, not cubic.
